visual.general_description: Surface EMG trace of a single swallow with printed markers M0, E1, M1, E1+1sec to E1+5sec, M2 and M2+1sec, an Execution stage bracket and a Base line box.
visual.detailed_description: One dense black EMG trace of spiky vertical deflections along a horizontal axis. Printed labels under the axis read M0, E1 with (M1-0.4sec) written beneath it, M1, E1+1sec, E1+2sec, E1+3sec, E1+4sec, E1+5sec, M2 and M2+1sec. A thin vertical line stands at M0, a thicker line at E1, and thinner lines at M1 and at each E1+1sec to E1+4sec label; a thicker line stands at E1+5sec. A rectangle labelled Execution stage spans the top from the E1 line to the E1+5sec line, and a smaller rectangle labelled Base line spans from the M2 line to the M2+1sec line. At the right a perpendicular scale bar is labelled 0.1 V (vertical) and 1 sec (horizontal). The trace shows denser and taller deflections inside the execution stage than before it or inside the baseline box.

visual.general_description: Electrode legend inset, five colour topographic maps of ERD/ERS and an EMG trace, with the printed case label "Case1".
visual.detailed_description: The upper part holds a bordered inset: a circular head outline with the words Anterior at the top, Posterior at the bottom, Lt on the left and Rt on the right, black dots for EEG electrodes, a blue oval over three electrodes at the front labelled Prefrontal area, yellow ovals at each side labelled Lateral sensorimotor area, a black curved line labelled Sylvian fissure and a blue line labelled Central sulcus. The words "Figure 2" and "Case1" are printed at the left. A colour bar at the right is labelled ERS log[µV²] at the top with +0.1, 0.0 and -0.1 and ERD at the bottom. Below are five circular topographic maps in a row, above a black EMG trace with a horizontal axis labelled E1, E1+1sec, E1+2sec, E1+3sec, E1+4sec and E1+5sec, thin vertical lines at E1 and E1+5sec, and scale bars labelled 0.1 V and 1 sec. The first two maps are predominantly warm orange to red with a few light-blue patches; the third map is mostly blue and light blue with an orange-red patch on one side; the fourth and fifth maps are dominated by blue and light blue, with a dark navy region along the upper edge of the circle.
